tasks.title: Verify checkout and baseline
evidence: Clean main checkout at f324046; pytest: 10 passed

tasks.title: Create progress ledger
evidence: tools/release_status.py validates 40 unique tasks, dependencies, evidence, and regenerates the Markdown checklist

tasks.title: Add versioned persistence
evidence: Migration regression preserves project, snapshot, review, conversation, message, and lesson data and creates a v1 backup

tasks.title: Build deterministic integration fixtures
evidence: Fake Codex fixture streams JSON events and covers valid, malformed, failure, stall, and child-process modes; fixture tests pass

tasks.title: Fix exclusions
evidence: Regression proves ignored JSON and scratch/ content are absent; mandatory exclusions are applied before project rules

tasks.title: Handle Git correctly
evidence: Regression detects a linked Git worktree with .git file and records branch, commit, dirty, detached, and root metadata

tasks.title: Capture a coherent snapshot
evidence: Capture retries the whole inventory once, marks persistent instability limited, writes blobs atomically, and reports true line counts

tasks.title: Enforce path boundaries
evidence: Canonical Windows identity rejects case-only duplicates; reparse points and app data are excluded; fingerprint check writes no blobs

tasks.title: Establish exclusive worker ownership
evidence: OS lock regression proves a second worker cannot acquire ownership or mutate a running job; Store construction is read-only for job states

tasks.title: Make the queue atomic and shared
evidence: Eight concurrent review requests return one constrained active job; atomic claims honor queued chat priority; CLI uses the shared queue

tasks.title: Implement cancellation throughout
evidence: Cancellation signal reaches capture, analysis, AI, rendering and chat; regression creates no review, does not advance schedule, and terminates a child process tree

tasks.title: Make scheduling and recovery predictable
evidence: Repeated scheduler checks create one occurrence, failures pause automatic retry, disabling scheduling cancels scheduled work only, and recovery requires ownership

tasks.title: Fix Python imports
evidence: AST regression covers package initializers, relative imports, named submodules, src layouts, evidence lines, and local/external/unresolved classification

tasks.title: Fix JavaScript and TypeScript imports
evidence: Pinned TypeScript compiler regression covers normalized relative paths, aliases, imports, re-exports, CommonJS, literal dynamic imports, and dynamic-expression omissions

tasks.title: Fix graph and manifest analysis
evidence: Iterative SCC test handles a 5,000-node graph deterministically; manifest test separates added, removed, and version-changed declarations

tasks.title: Make coverage accurate
evidence: Per-file parser/status/diagnostics distinguish compiler, fallback, syntax failure, unsupported content, unresolved imports, and limited DAZ analysis

tasks.title: Centralise model validation
evidence: Model tests reject duplicate IDs and dangling paths/relationships; snapshot validation enforces membership and locally marks exact citation ranges

tasks.title: Correct fallback teaching
evidence: Fallback regression leaves runtime path empty, labels execution order unconfirmed, uses source-backed static-cycle language, and makes no capture-process strength claim

tasks.title: Persist component identity
evidence: Component membership and positions are persisted separately; tests preserve IDs through unique hash renames and disclose ambiguous, split, and merge candidates

tasks.title: Use one semantic comparison engine
evidence: Automatic and selected comparisons share semantic_comparison; tests ignore wording, order, labels, citations, and geometry while separating confirmed and inferred edge changes

tasks.title: Define review fingerprints
evidence: Versioned review fingerprint includes goals, description, exclusions, parser/review versions, and Codex command while excluding project name and schedule

tasks.title: Record unchanged checks without duplicate reviews
evidence: Regression keeps one review, conversation, and lesson state while adding a history check event; force and limited-review regeneration are tested

tasks.title: Preserve legacy history
evidence: Migration compatibility test preserves legacy snapshot bytes, reviews, messages, and lessons and labels format/quality without enabling reuse

tasks.title: Validate comparison selection
evidence: Comparison rejects cross-project, running/failed, and legacy records and exposes branch and coverage differences through the shared engine

tasks.title: Restrict the analysis subprocess
evidence: Installed Codex CLI 0.154 capability check passed; adapter enforces read-only empty runtime, ignores user config/rules, disables shell/apps/hooks/browser/plugins/skills, and completed a real authenticated request

tasks.title: Bound source context and runtime
evidence: Deterministic packets prioritize manifests, entry points, changes, anchors, and connected files; tests enforce six 48,000-character packets, one repair, 300-second calls, and 900-second reviews

tasks.title: Stream progress and classify failures
evidence: Fake CLI tests prove events arrive before process completion, stderr drains concurrently, usage remains nullable/real, process trees time out cleanly, and auth/usage/malformed/incompatible errors are distinct

tasks.title: Finish snapshot-based chat
evidence: Chat test changes the live file then proves only saved source reaches Codex; ten-message/24,000-character history bounds, omission disclosure, validated citations, failure status, and cancellation are preserved

tasks.title: Apply global request protection
evidence: API regression rejects foreign clients, non-exact Host values, cross-site mutation Origins, and URL query tokens; HTML artifacts use CSP and sandboxed frames

tasks.title: Unify validation and settings
evidence: Partial PATCH regression preserves omitted project and application settings; forms share Pydantic validation and APIs return tested 404/409/422 responses

tasks.title: Keep saved reviews responsive
evidence: Saved-review regression loads after the source folder is removed; asynchronous fingerprint status reports checking/matches/changed/unavailable and writes no blobs

tasks.title: Finish review reading and progress states
evidence: Review UI presents purpose, architecture, changes, strengths, findings and lessons in order, exposes coverage/unresolved imports, job stage/elapsed/usage/error, schedule pauses, mobile navigation and focus states; 59 tests pass

tasks.title: Preserve reports when rendering fails
evidence: Regression forces renderer timeouts and proves two total attempts, layout-only repair, unchanged architecture facts, and a usable fallback report

tasks.title: Finish stable diagram delivery
evidence: Stable component and relationship IDs, persisted positions, principal relationships, supporting dependency tables, and separate selected-comparison artifacts are tested; pinned Archify sample compare passed 28/28 checks with a 2,215,985-byte artifact

tasks.title: Complete exports and implementation tasks
evidence: API tests download Markdown and HTML artifacts; reports contain evidence, limitations, lessons, answers, and exercises; Copy Codex task includes snapshot constraints, tradeoffs, and acceptance checks

tasks.title: Make installation and launch dependable
evidence: Clean checkout in a path containing spaces installed into .venv from exact requirements, passed 64 tests and doctor; a second launcher reused port 8877 and Exit app shut the sole server down cleanly

tasks.title: Add release regression and browser suites
evidence: 65 pytest regressions and three Playwright end-to-end scenarios pass against local Edge; Windows CI installs locked dependencies and uses only synthetic fixtures and fake Codex

tasks.title: Run real project acceptance
evidence: Private real-Codex reviews and snapshot-bound chats passed for tera (5 files, 16 valid citations), eucation (133 files, 35 valid citations), and non-Git dazscript (19 files, 33 valid citations); before/after source fingerprints and Git states matched

tasks.title: Perform self-review and lifecycle acceptance
evidence: Real Codex self-review completed without AI fallback and left the source fingerprint unchanged; four supported correctness findings were fixed with regressions; lifecycle and disposable edit-to-comparison flows pass in pytest and Playwright

tasks.title: Publish verified release work
evidence: Final privacy and diff checks passed; 70 pytest and three Playwright scenarios passed locally on Windows; GitHub Windows release checks passed for a1b7226; main was fast-forwarded without rewriting history
